faces.name: Part in Friendship
faces.oracleText: Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. If its mana value is less than or equal to the number of lands you control, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. This ability triggers only once each turn.

faces.name: Parting Gust
faces.oracleText:
Gift a tapped Fish (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a tapped 1/1 blue Fish creature token before its other effects.)
Exile target nontoken creature. If the gift wasn't promised, return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control with a +1/+1 counter on it at the beginning of the next end step.

faces.name: Parting Thoughts
faces.oracleText: Destroy target creature. You draw X cards and you lose X life, where X is the number of counters on that creature.

faces.name: Part the Veil
faces.oracleText: Return all creatures you control to their owner's hand.

faces.name: Part the Waterveil
faces.oracleText:
Take an extra turn after this one. Exile Part the Waterveil.
Awaken 6—{6}{U}{U}{U} (If you cast this spell for {6}{U}{U}{U}, also put six +1/+1 counters on target land you control and it becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with haste. It's still a land.)

faces.name: Part Water
faces.oracleText: X target creatures gain islandwalk until end of turn. (They can't be blocked as long as defending player controls an Island.)

faces.name: Party Crasher
faces.oracleText:
